profile.name: Kolawole Suleiman
profile.bio: Passionate about high-performance computing, interactive graphics, cloud automation, and building immersive web experiences with modern architecture.

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Engineering intuitive, high-performance systems and interactive visual architectures.
about.bio: I am a full-stack engineer and creative technologist. Blending mathematical precision with kinetic web aesthetics, I focus on building scalable web tools, high-throughput microservices, and reactive WebGL shaders that bridge human interaction and computational speed.

notes.title: Design & Systems Philosophy
notes.description: Chronophobic yet optimistic — designing software with high execution speed, zero bloat, intuitive typography, and durable systems thinking.

notes.title: Core Architecture & Domains
notes.description: Specialized in Reactive UI (React), WebGL/GLSL Shaders, Native Systems (C++/WebAssembly), Python Cloud Pipelines, and Workspace Automation.

notes.title: Current Research & Experiments
notes.description: N-body real-time gravitational simulations in browser viewports, autonomous worker queues on Render, and lightweight GPU canvas compositing.

projects.title: Cortex Invader
projects.tagline: A neon-drenched arcade space shooter with reactive particle shaders.
projects.description: Cortex Invader is a high-octane space shooter built directly for the browser, combining procedural wave mechanics with dynamic GLSL lighting algorithms and an original 80s synth aesthetic.

projects.title: Neural Sync Automator
projects.tagline: Autonomous data pipeline & notification engine connecting cloud endpoints.
projects.description: An enterprise automation engine bridging Google Workspace databases and cloud microservices. Uses Python worker queues deployed on Render and scheduled Google Apps Scripts to process distributed telemetry.

projects.title: Vortex Physics Engine
projects.tagline: Real-time multi-threaded N-body particle solver compiled for web.
projects.description: A high-performance physics simulation kernel written in modern C++ and compiled to WebAssembly. Simulates over 50,000 interacting gravitational bodies at 60 FPS in browser viewports.

projects.title: Hyperion Cloud Dashboard
projects.tagline: Real-time telemetry and edge deployment visualization monitor.
projects.description: A sleek, dark-mode observability dashboard monitoring microservice uptime, serverless execution latency, and edge CDN cache hit ratios across multi-region deployments.
